name: Microsoft KI-Rechenzentren Rheinisches Revier - Bergheim (Glessen)
notes: Microsoft ~3.2bn EUR Rheinisches Revier AI datacenter programme. Groundbreaking (Spatenstich) in Bergheim (Glessen industrial area) with ~2,500 jobs expected per WDR; at the symbolic groundbreaking on 2026-03-12 municipal politicians handed over building permits for Bergheim and Bedburg (stern). Status: under construction. Capacity MW not publicly disclosed for the individual site.

name: Microsoft KI-Rechenzentrum Bedburg
notes: WDR reported at the Bergheim groundbreaking that Microsoft also received a building permit (Baugenehmigung) for a large datacenter in Bedburg; stern confirms permits handed over for Bergheim and Bedburg on 2026-03-12; Radio Erft notes first approvals granted. Status: permitted with construction starting; recorded as construction per permit-handover and start-up reporting. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Microsoft KI-Rechenzentrum Elsdorf
notes: Elsdorf is the third Rhein-Erft-Kreis municipality in Microsoft 3.2bn EUR Rheinisches Revier investment (intercommunal Bergheim/Bedburg/Elsdorf cooperation; region-koeln-bonn, Rheinische Anzeigenblaetter). No permit or groundbreaking found for Elsdorf in this run - status announced/planned. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Microsoft-Rechenzentrum Grevenbroich
notes: WDR reported 2026-07-01 that Grevenbroich (Rhein-Kreis Neuss) received the award (Zuschlag) for a Microsoft datacenter as part of Rheinisches Revier structural transformation; BUND criticism of planned Microsoft RZ sites referenced by RP Online. Status announced as of evidence date; permit status to be verified. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Network Center Paderborn (NCPB) - VegaSystems
notes: Network Center Paderborn (Halberstaedter Str. 99, 33106 Paderborn) with attached ISO 27001-certified, CO2-free/energy-efficient datacenter; VegaSystems won WFG Paderborn Sust-Award 2023 for the facility. Operator official page = A for existence/operation. Capacity MW not published.

name: YEXIO Bad Lippspringe
notes: Data Center Map lists a YEXIO facility in Bad Lippspringe (Kreis Paderborn) among Paderborn-area facilities. Directory-level lead (C+); to be verified against operator page. No MW data.

name: TAL.DE Rechenzentrum Wuppertal
notes: Modern Level-3-standard datacenter in Wuppertal, green energy, PUE 1.2, redundant backbone, colocation/cloud services (operator official page). Datacenters.com also lists a second TAL.DE facility (Segundo Rechenzentrum) in Wuppertal. Capacity MW not published.

name: Portunity Rechenzentrum Wuppertal
notes: Portunity operates its own datacenter in Wuppertal since 1996 (server housing/colocation, plus racks in Duesseldorf). Operator official page = A for existence/operation. Capacity MW not published.

name: KRZN - Kommunales Rechenzentrum Niederrhein Kamp-Lintfort
developer: Zweckverband KRZN (Bottrop, Krefeld, Kreise Kleve, Mettmann, Viersen, Wesel)
notes: Kommunales Rechenzentrum Niederrhein, Friedrich-Heinrich-Allee 130, 47475 Kamp-Lintfort (Kreis Wesel), founded 1971; among the ten largest municipal IT providers in Germany, 500+ staff at Kamp-Lintfort and Mettmann, serving 43 municipal administrations. Official site = A. Municipal/government datacenter; capacity MW not published.

name: Dinfra Rechenzentrum Eiserfeld (Siegen)
notes: Dinfra GmbH operates a datacenter in Eiserfeld (Siegen). Siegener Zeitung reports insolvency proceedings opened at Amtsgericht Siegen due to Zahlungsunfaehigkeit and Ueberschuldung - facility future uncertain, status recorded as unknown. Local press = B-/C+; treat as C until operator confirmation.
